plugin_info.details: This plugin allows users to paste molecular structures from the clipboard in various text formats.
plugin_info.intro: Paste a molecule from the clipboard.
plugin_info.title: Paste from Clipboard

user_args.description: The name of the new, pasted molecule.
If appropriate for the file format, removes any counterions and keeps only the largest fragment.
user_args.label: Desalt molecules

user_args.description: For molecules without 3D coordinates (e.g., SMILES), choose how to generate those coordinates. Otherwise, this parameter is ignored.
user_args.label: Generate 3D coordinates

options.description: fastest: no forcefield optimization or conformer search
fast: quick forcefield optimization, no conformer search
medium: quick forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
better: medium forcefield optimization and fast conformer search
best: max forcefield optimization and thorough conformer search
